marc:datafield.marc:subfield: SWORD ART ONLINE : ALICIZATION-WAR OF UNDERWORLD. SEASON 3. VOL.1-23 END + 2 SPECIAL

Despite the defeat of Quinella the pontifex of the Axiom Church, things have not seemed to calm down yet. Upon contacting the real world, Kazuto "Kirito" Kirigaya finds out that the Ocean Turtle a mega-float controlled by Rath was raided. Due to a sudden short-circuit caused by the raiders, Kirito's fluctlight is damaged, leaving him comatose. Feeling insecure about the people at the Axiom Church, Alice brings the unconscious Kirito back to their hometown Rulid Village, disregarding her banishment due to an unabsolved crime.
